messages:
Asha: evening handoff — quick notes and asks
Asha: Heads up: I'll start the runtime-config rollout (PR #8423) Canary in ~10m at 21:15 UTC, 5% traffic. Expect a short latency bump during KV warmup.
Ben: ack. I'll keep an eye on p50/p95 and the GPU memory heatmap. Ping me if kv-cache evictions spike.
Carlos: FYI — shard-7 showed elevated evictions yesterday after the autoscaler tweak. If evictions > 100/s we should consider pausing.
Asha: rollback plan written in runbook: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime --to-revision=5` and set routing policy to `fallback-model-v2`. Also added a short checklist in the PR.
Ben: small ask on the job: can we add `--grace-period=60` to the warmup job? preprod saw OOM kills without it.
Asha: updated PR with `--grace-period=60`. Thanks.
Asha: Also scheduling a low-impact infra patch on the Dedicated pool at 23:00 UTC (non-blocking for hosted). Calling out because customers on reserved capacity may see reduced burst capacity for ~20m.
DevOps-bot: Scheduled maintenance: dedicated-pool-patch starting 2026-03-18T23:00:00Z, ETA 20m. Runbook: https://wiki.internal/ops/patches (:link:)
Carlos: Action items summary:
- Ben: watch canary (p50/p95, evictions, gpu_mem_pressure for shard-7)
- Asha: start canary, be ready to roll back if evictions > 100/s or p50 > 200ms
- Carlos: prepare fallback routing and smoke tests for `fallback-model-v2`
Ben: I'll also add a temporary alert: `gpu_mem_pressure > 80%` for shard-7 and a short slack alert to #eng-oncall.
Asha: thanks — I'm online for the next 2 hours. If anything looks off, @Ben or @Carlos please escalate. :thumbsup:
DevOps-bot: Canary started at 2523456900 (5% traffic).
Ben: seeing the expected warmup bump, p50 +45ms for 3m, evictions steady at ~12/s. Will update if it trends up.
Carlos: smoke tests for fallback-model-v2 passed in preprod. Ready to flip if needed.
Asha: great, closing the handoff. Will post a follow-up if we hit any of the thresholds.
__notes: single-thread Slack conversation; messages are compact and informal per agents.md guidelines
